description: This file contains tests for the 'allow-from' module, including functions for merging allow lists, resolving group allow lists, and utility functions like firstDefined and isSenderIdAllowed.

methods.name: mergeDmAllowFromSources
methods.description: Merges, trims, and filters empty values from allowFrom and storeAllowFrom lists, possibly filtering based on dmPolicy.

methods.name: resolveGroupAllowFromSources
methods.description: Determines which group allow list to use, preferring explicit group allowlist and optionally falling back to DM allowlist.

methods.name: firstDefined
methods.description: Returns the first argument that is not undefined.

methods.name: isSenderIdAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a sender ID is allowed based on the allowlist configuration.

ctags.name: name
ctags.pattern: /^      name: "keeps pairing-store entries for non-allowlist policies",$/
